name: Money Train 2

features.name: Money Cart bonus
features.description: Three respins where only bonus symbols land; respins reset with each new symbol.

features.name: Persistent symbols
features.description: Collector, Payer, Sniper and Necromancer symbols interact to boost values.

review:
Still the yardstick for money-cart bonuses. The fun is in the persistent special symbols: Collectors, Payers, Snipers and the Necromancer all stay on the grid and set each other off, so no two bonuses play out the same way.

It's very volatile, and plenty of bonuses end small. But it's one of the few games where even a weak bonus is fun to watch. Up to 50,000x, 96.4% RTP. There's no demo here, so look for it at a casino that offers one.
cons: Bonus can be expensive to reach
